correctness.rationale: The explicit 822-face matching-complex certificate checks 406 acyclic Morse pairs with critical cells one in dimension zero and nine in dimension three, proving the unquotiented integral sphere wedge. All 144500 nonempty chains of the barycentric subdivision are enumerated. For each of the four subgroup orbits, exact F2 Gaussian elimination over every orbit-boundary column gives Betti vectors (1,0,0,5,0,0), (1,0,0,4,0,0), (1,0,0,6,0,0), and (1,0,0,3,0,0), with d^2=0. Rank-over-Q follows from exact group coinvariants and computed orbit Euler characteristics. Exact coinvariants after inverting 2 exclude odd-primary torsion, and comparison of mod-2 and rational Betti vectors via UCT excludes 2-primary torsion. Every subgroup fixes the central horizontal grid edge as a matching-complex vertex, so Armstrong gives trivial fundamental group; Hurewicz and homological Whitehead yield the claimed four integral homotopy types. Replayed the embedded standalone checker from its real filesystem path.

value.rationale: The geometric quotient is a canonical invariant of symmetry for the first nonsquare width-four member of the recent three-row grid matching-complex family. All four nontrivial subgroup quotients are classified integrally, rather than reporting four arbitrary Betti numbers. Previous full-width character theorems already supply rational Euler values, but leave the topologically decisive two-primary torsion and fundamental groups unresolved. The new complete quotient homotopy classification distinguishes the four natural reflection subgroups by sphere multiplicities 5,4,6,3, and supplies a reusable exact orbit-chain method for nonfree simplicial actions. It is not an exercise of substituting parameters into those prior character formulas.
